preconditions.description: The root of the binary tree is provided.
The sum is a positive integer.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(return_value, list) and all(isinstance(path, list) for path in return_value)
postconditions.description: The function returns a list of paths, where each path is a list of integers representing the node values along the path.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(path) == sum for path in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each path sums up to the given sum.

postconditions.expression: all(not path or path[-1] is not None for path in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each path ends on a non-leaf node or is empty.
